proof_summary: A finite base analysis and an inductively propagated self-similarity of the first three iterated run-length encodings yield, for the row sum \(a_n\), row length \(L_n\), and the next two run counts \(r_n,q_n\), the recurrences \(a_{n+1}=a_n+L_n\), \(L_{n+1}=L_n+r_n\), \(r_{n+1}=r_n+q_n-1\), and \(q_{n+1}=q_n+L_{n-4}\). Choosing \(\lambda\in(3/2,2)\) with \(\lambda^4(\lambda-1)^3=1\), a positive linear potential in \(L,r,q\) obeys an affine geometric recurrence and is comparable to \(L_n\), giving \(a_n=\Theta(\lambda^n)\) and hence \(a_n^{1/n}\to\lambda\).
